name: php-better-snippets
description: This extension provides code snippets for PHP and Symfony framework, enabling you to code faster and be more productive.

php-better-snippets.enable-symfony-snipp.description: Enable Symfony-related snippets (controllers, Doctrine, Messenger, Scheduler, attributes, etc.). Disable this if you only work with plain PHP projects.

php-better-snippets.enable-auto-imports.description: Automatically insert the required `use` statement at the top of the file when accepting a snippet that depends on an imported class (e.g. `use Doctrine\ORM\Mapping as ORM;` for Doctrine attribute snippets). Disable this if you prefer to manage imports yourself or your PHP extension already does this.
